## A Figure from an R Chunk

```{r}
#| label: plot-penguins
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4.5
ggplot(penguins, aes(bill_len, bill_dep, color = species, shape = species)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 20)
```
